enroll.title: Visiting Filak is your first step

ageGroups.title: Age Groups
intro: The early years of life are full of discovery, play, and experience. Children’s learning during this period is deeply connected to their emotions and inner world. At Filak, with the support of caring teachers and in a safe and joyful environment, we stand beside your little ones to make every day full of growth, happiness, and learning.
We know every child is unique. That’s why children are placed in groups based on their age and needs, so they can flourish in the right environment and share new experiences with their peers.

groups.label: Infants
groups.description: The very first steps into the world of learning and communication. In a safe and calm environment, infants are cared for with sensitivity and attention to their needs. During this period, our main focus is on creating a sense of security, responding to physical needs, and gradually initiating the first steps of communication.

groups.label: Toddlers
groups.description: As children become more active and curious, they begin exploring their surroundings more independently. In this group, they have opportunities to take part in purposeful games and movement-based activities, discover the world around them, and practise their earliest social skills.

groups.label: Little Explorers
groups.description: A period for nurturing creativity and strengthening self-confidence. Children at this age discover their abilities through artistic activities, storytelling, and group games, while gradually learning how to express themselves and build confidence.

groups.label: Preschool I
groups.description: A stage for preparing children for deeper learning, concentration, group participation, language development, and creative thinking. Children can experience more structured games, learn to enter new environments confidently, and communicate more effectively with others.

groups.label: Preschool II
groups.description: The final step before entering primary school, focusing on cognitive, social, and emotional skills. Through educational activities, group games, and small projects, children become prepared to enter school with confidence and essential abilities.

items.label: Qualified Staff
items.description: Our experienced and caring educators support every child with thoughtful guidance, individual attention, and age-appropriate learning throughout the day.

items.label: Safety & Monitoring
items.description: Carefully planned safety measures and continuous monitoring help us maintain a secure, calm environment for children, families, and staff.

items.label: Art & Creativity
items.description: A welcoming creative space gives children room to paint, build, imagine, and express their ideas through hands-on artistic experiences.

items.label: Indoor Playroom
items.description: Our indoor playroom provides a comfortable setting for movement, collaborative games, and active discovery in every season.

items.label: Outdoor Playground
items.description: The outdoor playground encourages fresh-air exploration, physical confidence, and joyful social play in a child-friendly setting.

items.label: Kitchen & Dining
items.description: A clean kitchen and inviting dining area support nutritious meals while helping children practise healthy and social mealtime habits.

items.label: Rest Area
items.description: Our quiet rest area offers children a peaceful, comfortable place to relax and recharge as part of their daily rhythm.

items.label: Lab & Library
items.description: Books, simple experiments, and discovery-based activities invite children to ask questions and develop an early love of learning.

items.label: Storytelling Hall
items.description: A dedicated storytelling space brings books and imagination to life through shared reading, performance, and creative conversation.

items.label: Media Room
items.description: The media room supports carefully selected visual and interactive learning experiences designed for young children.

sections.title: About Filak
paragraphs: Filak Kindergarten was founded in 2016 with the goal of providing holistic and engaging education, nurturing children who are energetic and lively, and preparing them for a better individual and social life.

Filak’s main concern has always been building a strong foundation for children to acquire personal and social skills so they can succeed in all stages of their lives. This mission is pursued through the cooperation of experienced and skilled staff, along with precise planning.

We are proud to note that as a result of these efforts, on 16 November 2020, Filak Kindergarten was recognized as the only four-star kindergarten in Isfahan and one of the few four-star centers in Iran. We are committed to maintaining this position and vision.

sections.title: Why Filak
paragraphs: Every moment of a child’s presence at Filak is shaped through purposeful and structured planning. This approach ensures that activities are not merely for entertainment, but rather guide children toward intellectual and skillful growth.

The kindergarten environment is designed with a variety of educational stations so children are constantly moving, exploring, and experimenting. This dynamism is an inseparable part of their daily identity and provides the foundation for discovering personal and social abilities.

We believe that true learning arises from experience and active participation. This perspective is reflected throughout our activities and is rooted in modern educational philosophies that prioritize the holistic development of the child.

sections.title: Filak’s Team
paragraphs: Every section of Filak Kindergarten is run by a team of specialized and trained professionals to ensure that activities proceed with greater order and quality. This structure allows each educational, care, and support unit to perform at its best.

From teachers to the educational, caregiving, and support staff, everyone works together in harmony and team spirit. The presence of diverse and knowledgeable staff in each department, along with up-to-date expertise and work experience, guarantees children’s safety and parents’ peace of mind.

Professionalism and responsibility are values we always emphasize. These principles help us create a safe and reliable environment that fosters trust and provides the foundation for the all-round growth of children.
